svg.title: Fams, faculty appraisal management system
svg.desc: Plate VII. The title FAMS, drawn as exact construction geometry: public code. Three boxes joined by arrows: Faculty, with eleven sections and self-scores; Head of Department, who approves and forwards; Principal, the final decision. Beneath them a line of ticks, the audit trail, with an ember travelling along it. Read-only from submission. Dashed, not built: self-service password reset, e-mail delivery, SSO.
